messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list; the directly supported automotive signaling focus is NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G/5G, PSAP simulation, voice/data and MSD transfer, hybrid eCall fallback under degraded conditions, audio/speech-quality verification, and GNSS-related eCall testing. [10][12][28][84]
### Key signaling test capabilities for Automotive
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Knowledge-base-supported product / option facts | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over LTE/5G IMS | EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including 4G LTE and 5G NR, and the source says NG eCall becomes obligatory from 2026-01-01. | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions. | [10][12] |
| PSAP simulation and end-to-end voice/data transmission | The CMX500 verification simulated a PSAP and validated NG eCall voice and data transmission at both ends against EN 17240:2024. | R&S CMX500 was used as the mobile radio tester in the verification process. | [10][13] |
| IMS eCall procedure coverage | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; eCall-only IVS cases; MSD transfer and update; negative or missing AL-ACK; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; PSAP callback; clear-down; and LTE/EPS plus 5GS/NR eCall-over-IMS cases. | R&S CMX-KA098 is the CMX500 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option, and its capability list covers NGeCall over NR-LTE / LTE tests. | [28][91] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback and robustness | Hybrid eCall testing verifies that vehicle emergency call systems work reliably across NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths, including fallback when coverage or service quality degrades. | The R&S CMX-KA09x eCall evaluation solution is stated to support EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance, with CMX-KA099 for EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios and CMX-KA098 for EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios. | [26][36][84] |
| Network scenario emulation for eCall | Listed scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation and various network scenario emulation. | The solution context is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester and updated eCall option. | [27][87] |
| Audio, codecs and speech-quality testing | Automotive eCall validation needs intelligible voice quality, and CMX500 application/audio options support IMS voice codecs, POLQA perceived speech-quality measurement, WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay. | CMX-KA180 provides AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS codecs for 4G/5G IMS voice calls; CMX-KA181 adds POLQA; CMX-KA401 adds WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay. | [4][84] |
| GNSS-related eCall receiver/performance testing | Hybrid eCall validation includes maintaining GNSS positioning, and the eCall GNSS Testing configuration is for eCall GNSS receiver / performance testing. | The configuration uses R&S SMBV100B with GNSS-related options and an eCall Test Suite GNSS performance test option for eCall modules. | [24][83][84] |
| Application/IP service and traffic testing around IMS services | CMX500 application test options support internal IP services and IP connection to DUT applications, including DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, QoS, delay measurement and IP traffic analysis. | CMX-KA100 provides basic application/IP services; CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF and delay measurement; CMX-KA150 provides IP traffic analysis. | [4] |
### Additional supported automotive-adjacent capability
【推論】V2X / C-V2X signaling should be treated as an automotive-relevant candidate capability because the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as supporting V2X, while the CMX500 feature set lists LTE C-V2X and NR C-V2X; the passages do not provide a dedicated automotive C-V2X test-case list. [40][103]
### Limits
The passages do not provide a formal ranked priority list, full test-case matrix, pass/fail limits, software-version-complete setup, or proof that every EN 17240 / EN 18052 requirement is covered. [70][73][85][86]

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |

| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。

- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。

- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

- 來源明示 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 有時只支援部分測試，或某些測試需要 further equipment。

CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700 › 規格條件與可信度限制
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 指定規格需符合至少 15 minutes warm-up time、指定 environmental conditions、calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 代表 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 是 design parameters，產品開發期間驗證，但 production 期間不特別測試，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- 每台儀器在生產流程中依 defined procedures 校正；放行條件包含所有 measurement results 與 calibration system measurement uncertainties 必須落在 published specification limits 內。
- Calibration system expanded measurement uncertainties 以 coverage factor k = 2 決定，通常約 95 % probability。
- 斜體參數可直接在 tester 上設定。

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，R&S CMX-KM600 option 的 5G NR analyzer 條件為 FR1、SCS 30 kHz、16QAM、temperature range +15 °C to +35 °C；input level –25 dBm to –10 dBm RMS、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。Frequency measurement uncertainty：**< 20 Hz + drift of timebase**；相對於同一台 CMX500 device 的 downlink signal 進行 frequency error measurements 時，uncertainty 符合 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] V18.5.0。

R&S CMX-KW601 option 的 5G NR generator 條件：5G NR PDSCH、full allocation、SCS 30 kHz / 60 kHz、modulation 64QAM、PAR 11.8 dB、temperature +15 °C to +35 °C；ports RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4；output level –5 dBm、bandwidth 100 MHz 時 EVM **< 0.5 %**。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked “most important” list; the directly supported automotive signaling focus is NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G/5G, PSAP simulation, voice/data and MSD transfer, hybrid eCall fallback under degraded conditions, audio/speech-quality verification, and GNSS-related eCall testing. [10][12][28][84]
### Key signaling test capabilities for Automotive
| Capability | Why it matters for Automotive | Knowledge-base-supported product / option facts | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over LTE/5G IMS | EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over IMS networks, including 4G LTE and 5G NR, and the source says NG eCall becomes obligatory from 2026-01-01. | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions. | [10][12] |
| PSAP simulation and end-to-end voice/data transmission | The CMX500 verification simulated a PSAP and validated NG eCall voice and data transmission at both ends against EN 17240:2024. | R&S CMX500 was used as the mobile radio tester in the verification process. | [10][13] |
| IMS eCall procedure coverage | CMX-KA098 test scope includes IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; eCall-only IVS cases; MSD transfer and update; negative or missing AL-ACK; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; PSAP callback; clear-down; and LTE/EPS plus 5GS/NR eCall-over-IMS cases. | R&S CMX-KA098 is the CMX500 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option, and its capability list covers NGeCall over NR-LTE / LTE tests. | [28][91] |
| Hybrid eCall fallback and robustness | Hybrid eCall testing verifies that vehicle emergency call systems work reliably across NG eCall and classic CS eCall transport paths, including fallback when coverage or service quality degrades. | The R&S CMX-KA09x eCall evaluation solution is stated to support EN 18052:2025 and EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 compliance, with CMX-KA099 for EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios and CMX-KA098 for EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios. | [26][36][84] |
| Network scenario emulation for eCall | Listed scenarios include VoNR, VoLTE, circuit-switched fallback, handovers, degraded radio conditions, real-world mobile network condition simulation and various network scenario emulation. | The solution context is based on the R&S CMX500 radio communication tester and updated eCall option. | [27][87] |
| Audio, codecs and speech-quality testing | Automotive eCall validation needs intelligible voice quality, and CMX500 application/audio options support IMS voice codecs, POLQA perceived speech-quality measurement, WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay. | CMX-KA180 provides AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS codecs for 4G/5G IMS voice calls; CMX-KA181 adds POLQA; CMX-KA401 adds WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA and end-to-end audio delay. | [4][84] |
| GNSS-related eCall receiver/performance testing | Hybrid eCall validation includes maintaining GNSS positioning, and the eCall GNSS Testing configuration is for eCall GNSS receiver / performance testing. | The configuration uses R&S SMBV100B with GNSS-related options and an eCall Test Suite GNSS performance test option for eCall modules. | [24][83][84] |
| Application/IP service and traffic testing around IMS services | CMX500 application test options support internal IP services and IP connection to DUT applications, including DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, QoS, delay measurement and IP traffic analysis. | CMX-KA100 provides basic application/IP services; CMX-KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF and delay measurement; CMX-KA150 provides IP traffic analysis. | [4] |
### Additional supported automotive-adjacent capability
【推論】V2X / C-V2X signaling should be treated as an automotive-relevant candidate capability because the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF is described as supporting V2X, while the CMX500 feature set lists LTE C-V2X and NR C-V2X; the passages do not provide a dedicated automotive C-V2X test-case list. [40][103]
### Limits
The passages do not provide a formal ranked priority list, full test-case matrix, pass/fail limits, software-version-complete setup, or proof that every EN 17240 / EN 18052 requirement is covered. [70][73][85][86]

| SMBVB-K44 | SW | 1423.7753.02 | GPS (6 SVs) | mandatory |
| SMBV-K66 | SW | 1423.7882.02 | GALILEO (6 SVs) | mandatory；required for GNSS Multiband and GALILEO Support |

來源另註明：[[R&S SMBV100B]] is a 1G product；configuration、prices 等問題需聯絡 1G product management team。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › unresolved
- [[EN 18052]] 的完整標準標題、發布組織與正式版本細節尚未由本來源提供。

- 來源未提供 degraded radio conditions、handover 與 voice quality 測試的具體設定。

Hybrid eCall testing › 使用限制

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。

- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

R&S CMX-KA098
R&S CMX-KA098 是 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option；[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]]（November 2024；文件版次來源未標示）把它列為 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] license swap recipient，[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Dec. 2024；文件版次來源未標示）則提供 CMX500 搭配 CMX-KA098 執行 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] / [[NGeCall over LTE]] capability tests 的支援清單。[[CMX500_Software_Maintenance_PU-Option_Mapping]]（表頭標示 28.10.2025/CH）進一步補出它的 Ident No、短文字與 software maintenance service contract PU mapping。
